# dramapack

> dramapack is an open-source (Apache-2.0) Python CLI and MCP server by Dawnwood that turns short-drama episodes (vertical dramas, micro dramas, AI dramas) into platform-ready delivery packages: TikTok Drama Center / DramaWave / ReelShort submission packs, -14 LUFS constant-gain mastering, burned subtitles inside the subtitle safe area, clean masters, 3:4 covers, acceptance audits against market benchmarks, and music/font rights checks.

Install: `pip install dramapack` (needs ffmpeg). Agents: `claude mcp add dramapack -- dramapack mcp`, tools `inspect`, `master`, `package`, `audit`, `check_rights`. CLI subcommands take `--json`; exit codes 0 ok, 1 red, 2 usage, 3 failure.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/dawnwood-ai/dramapack/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, quickstart
- [How to build a TikTok Drama Center delivery package](https://github.com/dawnwood-ai/dramapack/blob/main/docs/tiktok-drama-center-delivery-package.md): what platforms ask for and the one-command pack
- [Why short dramas should be mastered at -14 LUFS](https://github.com/dawnwood-ai/dramapack/blob/main/docs/short-drama-loudness-14-lufs.md): phone-speaker loudness and why ffmpeg loudnorm lifts the noise floor
- [Keeping burned subtitles inside the safe area](https://github.com/dawnwood-ai/dramapack/blob/main/docs/subtitle-safe-area.md): 18% bottom / 16% side margins, ASS PlayRes pitfall
- [What is a clean master](https://github.com/dawnwood-ai/dramapack/blob/main/docs/clean-master.md): textless master, same edit as the subtitled one
- [Music and font rights checklist](https://github.com/dawnwood-ai/dramapack/blob/main/docs/music-font-rights-checklist.md): major labels, public domain, licences, commercial-free fonts
- [Using dramapack from an AI agent (MCP)](https://github.com/dawnwood-ai/dramapack/blob/main/docs/ai-agent-mcp.md): MCP server, tools, JSON CLI, Claude Code plugin
